expert-model.title: Models and run allowances
expert-model.intro: Choose once per role, with optional task overrides. This only reads current tool options and never calls a model.
expert-model.individual_help: Choose a separate model, parameters and allowance for a checked task. Uncheck to use the role selection.
expert-model.budget_help: Each task reserves and settles its own allowance. These are not shared team-plan budgets; dependency waits use no execution slot.
